description: Energieopslagsystemen die gekoppeld zijn aan het distributienet is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). Deze dataset bevat voor alle door Fluvius gekende energieopslagsystemen die gekoppeld zijn aan het distributienet het jaartal indienstname, vermogen en het spanningsniveau van de aansluiting. Disclaimer: Fluvius spant zich in om volledige en actuele informatie aan te bieden. Niettemin kan Fluvius niet garanderen dat alle weergegeven informatie en data volledig of correct is. Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Energietransitie: adoptie van nieuwe technologieën. Its keywords are Energie opslagsysteem, Elektriciteit, Thuisbatterij, Batterij. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
